pages.text: A variant of the Wind Robes that takes the very lightning in its fabrics. Much like the Wind Robes, the robes allows you to fall slowly. Wearing the Robes also halves the Soul Cost for Storm Spells, but not Wind Spells unfortunately.
Creatures of the storms slowly heal themselves with their summoner's soul energy, should they wear this robe.
The Storm Crown reduce the amount of time to cast Storm spells by half and keeps your storm servants from dying off like Vexes.
